subject.title: [Feature]: Add an optional result-return mode for /hooks/agent

question: Should authenticated hook callers be allowed to synchronously receive agent output from `POST /hooks/agent`, and if so what result, error, timeout, replay, and audit contract should be supported?
rationale: Source inspection proves the feature gap, but the durable public API and security boundary cannot be chosen safely by cleanup automation.

options.title: Adopt the linked PR shape with hardening
options.body: Use `waitForResult` plus `announceToMain` on the existing endpoint, with explicit limits or redaction if maintainers require them before merge.

options.title: Choose a narrower sync contract
options.body: Redirect the implementation toward a dedicated sync endpoint, bounded envelope, or short-lived result reference if raw synchronous output is too broad for hook auth.

options.title: Decline core support for now
options.body: Keep the documented async hook plus `sessions_history` workaround and close the linked PR if maintainers decide this should remain downstream-specific.

recommendation.title: Adopt the linked PR shape with hardening
recommendation.body: Use `waitForResult` plus `announceToMain` on the existing endpoint, with explicit limits or redaction if maintainers require them before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the gateway HTTP API shape, security posture, and existing hook endpoint ownership where this history is strongest.
